configurePresets.name: player-debug
configurePresets.description: Primary development build with ImGui debug overlays enabled. Recommended for game development and Lua debug tooling.

configurePresets.name: player-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized player with no ImGui or profiling. Fast dev iteration; use ship-release for a standalone packaged artifact.

configurePresets.name: player-profile
configurePresets.description: Optimized build with profiling instrumentation enabled. No ImGui.

configurePresets.name: ship-release
configurePresets.description: Shippable artifact: no ImGui or profiling, loads the baked asset_manifest.lua (no FS scan). Canonical desktop shipping config; mobile (Android/iOS) shipping build support is experimental / work-in-progress.

configurePresets.name: ship-mac-universal
configurePresets.description: Shippable macOS .app: universal binary (arm64 + x86_64) so one .dmg runs on both Apple silicon and Intel. Uses the universal-osx overlay triplet so vcpkg deps are fat too. macOS-only — vcpkg's universal triplet drives lipo'd dylibs/static archives that Linux/Windows hosts can't cross-build.
